title: DHCT-GAN strict
subtitle: Thesis model

nodes.title: Context and scaling
description: Map context/electrodes to branch input; normalise by configured scale.

nodes.title: Independent clean branch
description: Configured FC or convolutional decoder predicts clean waveform.

nodes.title: Independent noise branch
description: Separate parameters and CNN/LGTB feature blocks.

nodes.title: Two gating masks
description: Masks come from the scaled input.
Fused clean = mask1 x clean + mask2 x (input - noise).

nodes.title: Rescale and select centre
description: Return clean, noise and fused outputs; optional channel bridge.
Artifact export uses noisy centre minus the selected clean output.
